question: Do paired endpoint examples improve completion boundaries, and does changing only other strokes add background robustness?
model: Full frozen Show-o2-1.5B-w-video-und native visual path; original language adapter, target localizer and ink head unchanged. Only 57,764-parameter state heads continue training.

arms.replay: Original full and highest partial state, each repeated twice per target.
arms.endpoint: Full and assigned pixel gap on half-stroke background, each repeated twice.
arms.paired: Same full and gap states, once on half background and once with independently varied other strokes.

training.loss: Four-class cross entropy only; no additional pair, consistency or ranking loss.
training.sampling: Same original indices and target-family indices for all arms; all four family members appear together.
training.class_weights: Inverse class probability of the 50:50 original/supplement mixture, fixed before training and identical across arms.
training.initialization: Each region starts from its existing coverage head; optimizer reset. Oracle and predicted regions each run all three arms.

evaluation.policy: All conditions fixed before training. Final weights only; no threshold/checkpoint selection. Baseline, all arms on their own region; predicted-region arms also on oracle regions.
evaluation.metrics: Per-gap and macro completion, full/partial pair both correct, all-gap success, background-pair both correct and answer flips, old presence/unknown/reference/target pairs, training fit. Whole-geometry bootstrap.

scope: Training geometry and development geometry remain disjoint. Development geometry was previously inspected; new backgrounds are prospective inputs, not independent acceptance. No original 130-case test, Chinese/order/H2/H3 or native-language claim.
interpretation: Replay versus endpoint changes both gap coverage and context; it is a combined data intervention. Endpoint versus paired isolates the replacement of duplicate half-background slots by varied backgrounds. Sample slots and update budget are matched, unique image diversity is not.
